query: Consider the Terms of Collaboration Agreement between McGill University and Mitacs; Does the document mention that some obligations of the Agreement may survive the termination of the Agreement?
gold:
The obligation to safeguard Confidential Information shall continue for a period of two (2) years from the date the internship/fellowship terminates or expires.
19. SURVIVAL: Notwithstanding the foregoing, the provisions of Section 3.2 (the academic and research license); Section 3.4 (Publication); Section 4 (Indemnification); Section 7 (Non-Disclosure); and Section 11 (Warranties) and will survive the end or other termination of the Project.

judge.gold_summary: 协议规定部分义务在终止后继续有效，包括保密信息保护义务在实习/ fellowship 终止或到期后持续两年；第19条 Survival 明确第3.2、3.4、4、7、11条在 Project 结束或终止后存续。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答确认协议提到终止后存续义务，列出第19条 Survival 所涉条款（3.2、3.4、4、7、11），并补充第7.2规定保密信息保护义务在实习/ fellowship 终止或到期后持续两年。
judge.reason: 系统回答完整覆盖了金标中的关键要点：保密义务两年存续以及第19条 Survival 所列条款，且与金标不存在矛盾。
